caption: The drawing features a metallic candlestick holder with a tall, cylindrical shaft as its central structure. At the top of the shaft is a wide, flat circular lip with an opening designed to hold a candle. Attached to one side of the shaft is a curved handle, allowing the holder to be carried. On the opposite side, there is a coiled, decorative extension that protrudes horizontally. The base of the holder is an elongated oval tray with shallow sides, which surrounds the bottom of the shaft and is likely intended to catch drips from the candle. The drawing uses various shades of gray to represent the metallic texture and create shading that defines the shapes and gives the object a three-dimensional appearance. The overall composition is rendered on a plain, light-colored background. The artist’s signature, “Amelia Tuccio,” appears in the lower left corner.
title: Candlestick
